positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and tested modeling and simulation software solutions for the defense industry. 
• Created web applications with intuitive GUIs and secure RESTful APIs using Python, Flask, TypeScript, and React. 
• Developed desktop applications leveraging TypeScript, React, and Electron. 
• Enhanced and modernized legacy simulation programs written in C++. 
• Implemented extensive testing using Pytest (functional), Cypress (integration), and k6 (scalability). 
• Authored detailed documentation including READMEs, user guides, technical manuals, and 4+1 architectural view models to streamline onboarding and maintenance. 
• Automated testing and documentation pipelines with Jenkins and GitLab CI/CD to enhance software reliability and streamline development workflow. 
• Collaborated using GitLab for version control, code reviews, and managing merge requests. 
• Adhered to Agile methodologies, participating in daily stand-up meetings and sprint-based workflows across multiple projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · JavaScript · React.js · Web Application Development · Modeling and Simulation

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Contributed to the .NET team by implementing new features for internal tools using C#. 
• Designed and optimized database queries using SQL and Access. 
• Decommissioned outdated legacy applications. 
• Created detailed, well-structured documentation and wrote clean, maintainable code. 
• Worked within an Agile framework, utilizing a Kanban board to track progress and manage tasks effectively.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed a computer vision model using Python and YOLOv5 to identify and classify microplastics within a microfluidics system. 
• Optimized model training performance by leveraging CUDA for GPU acceleration, significantly reducing processing time. 
• Built a live detection feed with Arena SDK and Python to recognize microplastics in real time. 
• Designed a video analysis script in Python to generated detailed statistics on detected objects.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Computer Vision · Microfluidics · YOLOv5 · Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed scripts to perform web scraping for a variety of data sources using Python and JavaScript. 
• Built program to execute large-scale data collection for natural language processing (NLP) features using 
Python. 
• Collaborated in daily scrum meetings to align with Agile workflows and project goals.
